card: Enables thirteen clang-tidy bugprone checks and resolves existing violations in tests and Qt code. The checks detect subtle potential issues like dangling handles, improper container erasures, and missing lifetime annotations. Apart from resolving an embedded NUL string truncation in util_tests, the author notes the checks found no severe issues in current code but help prevent future defects in CI.
changed_since_previous: Now includes the complete patch; confirms the exact set of 13 newly enabled clang-tidy checks and corresponding fixes in Qt and test files.
evidence: Description notes: 'Apart from a test-only bug, they didn't find anything severe, but I think it still makes sense to enable them, so that it is easier to read the resulting code.'
Commit fa8c949e4c notes that enabling bugprone-string-literal-with-embedded-nul fixed an existing test bug where embedded NUL characters in string literals were truncated.
problem: Clang-tidy configuration does not enforce multiple bugprone checks, leaving the codebase open to subtle bugs such as inaccurate container erasure, accidental string truncation from embedded NULs, dangling handles, and missing lifetime annotations.

risk.why: Changes are limited to linter configuration, unit tests, and minor non-consensus Qt helper routines.

scope_notes: Small mechanical cleanup across several files to satisfy the new clang-tidy rules.
summary: Enables thirteen additional clang-tidy bugprone checks in .clang-tidy and fixes code flagged by the newly enabled checks. Adjustments include using C++20 std::erase in WalletController, properly constructing strings with embedded NUL characters in util_tests, marking an unused RAII construct in tests, and adding a LIFETIMEBOUND annotation in notificator.cpp.
